public_key.description: The node's primary public key as "ed25519:<base64url raw 32-byte key>". null when the deployment has no key configured, in which case the node must not advertise the verify or delegate capability. The field is always present so a reader can tell a keyless node from a malformed one.

crypto_profile.description: Key profile the node publishes under, e.g. pqc-hybrid-v1.

ed25519_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding. Import it directly as a raw key: it is the same 32 bytes as the tail of the SPKI encoding. null when no key is configured.

pqc_public_key.description: ML-DSA-65 public key, base64url without padding. null when no post-quantum half exists.

capability_notes.description: What the advertised verbs mean on this node. A capability describes configured key material, never authority over anyone.

last_sync.description: Deprecated. rcan.dev no longer emits this: a value stamped per request is a generation time, not a sync time.

manifest_signature.description: Self-signature over the canonical JSON of this manifest with manifest_signature removed. To check it: delete the manifest_signature member, serialise the rest as canonical JSON (object keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit, recursively, no whitespace, UTF-8 bytes), then verify sig, the raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature base64url encoded without padding, against ed25519_public_key. Everything outside this object is inside the signed bytes; reason and note sit inside it and are not. sig and kid are null when the node has no usable signing key, and reason says which variable is missing. A self-signature proves control of the published key and nothing about the operator's independence.
